name: Open evidence limitations
questionAnswered: How many declared evidence limitations remain open in the named assessment scope, and how many currently block a conclusion?

calculation.formula: count open limitation records and the blocking subset at the projection as-of time
calculation.rounding: Counts remain integers and are never converted into a success percentage.

scopeSemantics.qualification: A zero count is meaningful only when the limitation register was evaluated for the named scope; absence of a register is unavailable.

interpretation.doesMean: The stated number of explicit evidence constraints remains unresolved in the named scope.
doesNotMean: Zero declared limitations proves complete evidence.
The count measures technical risk severity.
A limitation has been accepted as an exception.
interpretation.whenUnavailable: Show unavailable when the limitation register has not been evaluated for the named scope.
